blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — A late-night residential fire struck Barangay Pitogo in Consolacion town in northern Cebu on Wednesday, September 30, affecting 47 families made up of 170 individuals. According to the Consolacion Fire Station, the blaze broke out at 10:32 p.m., prompting an immediate response from firefighters and other emergency responders in the area.
